parameters.name: screen
parameters.description: This query parameter is indicative of the screen where the API is being invoked.

parameters.name: retainSearch
parameters.description: marks the selected filters and search query to be retained by the last search API

parameters.name: bookingEndAtLessThan
parameters.description: Filter bookings ending before this date (format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm)

parameters.name: bookingStartAtGreaterThan
parameters.description: Filter bookings starting after this date (format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm)

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort order for team members (default: BOOKING_COUNT)
